issues.description: Column naming inconsistency: the solution (solution_repository/aufgabe04.sql, line 1) selects the column regierungsbezirk but renames it with an alias as 'District' (SELECT regierungsbezirk AS District ...). The problem statement (problem_statement.md, lines 101-103) explicitly instructs students not to rename columns with AS unless requested, and the task description (problem_statement.md, lines 120-123) refers to the field using the German term 'Regierungsbezirk'. This mismatch between the solution's aliased column name and the problem text/instructions can confuse students about the expected column name and may cause automated equality checks (which verify selected column names) to fail or be unclear.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the alias in the solution so the column retains the original name used in the problem statement. Change solution_repository/aufgabe04.sql line 1 from "SELECT regierungsbezirk AS District, SUM(einwohner_w), SUM(einwohner_m)" to "SELECT regierungsbezirk, SUM(einwohner_w), SUM(einwohner_m) ...". Alternatively, if an English alias is desired, update the problem statement to explicitly allow this alias for this task and state the expected column name in the grader rules.
